liveObservation.screen: Vite was started before Electron. Live 1000x720 Blurby Electron UI opened. Page static two-column EPUB navigation observed; Focus RSVP word advanced while playing and stopped on pause; Flow highlighted text and followed/browsed while playing; Narrate selected/playing state, visible cursor and chapter movement observed. Screenshots captured for Page, Focus and Flow. UI control was intermittent due concurrent input/window resizing; no complete canonical-index matrix. The owner later reported that Flow blinked and did not stabilize in the live session. A read-only capture showed Flow selected with content rendered but did not establish the blink mechanism. The dev Electron log showed ENOENT renames for library.json.tmp and sync-queue.json.tmp; no causal link to Flow is proven.
liveObservation.heardAudio: LIVE OBSERVATION ROUTE VERIFIED: the owner confirmed hearing Narrate in this session and reported the visible cursor ahead of spoken narration, with reload jumping speech forward to catch it. No simultaneous exact-word/timing pair was supplied. WASAPI Realtek USB2.0 Headphones loopback recorded RMS 0.0/peak 0.0 for 5 seconds paused and RMS 0.0721/peak 0.9475 for 10 seconds during Narrate playing at 48 kHz. This is output evidence but does not itself identify spoken words. The earlier 16-kHz capture was silent and invalid.
